spans.s:
m. (-यः)
The lower part of the body, the lower extremities.
E.
अधस्, and काय body.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Thrown or put down.
E.
अधस्, and कृत made.

mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं)
Precipitated, thrown down.
E.
अधस् down, and क्षिप्त participle past of क्षिप् to throw.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Fallen down.
E.
अधस्, and पतित fallen.

m. (-रः)
A seat or bed, made of grass.
E.
अधस्, and प्रस्तर a couch.

f. (-ष्पी)
A plant, (Hieracium.)
E.
अधस् downwards, and पुष्प a flower.

mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं)
1

Below.
2

Inferior.
E.
अधस्, and स्थ what stays.

mfn. (-मः-मा-मं)
1 Inferior, low.
2 Vile, despicable.
E.
अब to preserve, अम Uṇādi affix, and व changed to ध.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
1 A porter, a bearer of burdens.
2 Low, servile.
E.
अधम low, and भृतक a servant.

mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं)
A debtor.
E.
अधम low, and ऋण debt.

m. (-कः)
A debtor.
E.
अधम, and ऋण debt, with ठक added.

m. (-र्णी)
A debtor.
E.
अधम, and ऋण debt, with इनि added.

n. (-ङ्गं)
A foot.
E.
अधम low, and अङ्ग a limb.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
1 Low, inferior, below.
2 Low, vile.
3 Silenced, refuted, overcome in abuse or controversy.
f. (-रा)
The lower region.
m. (-रः)
The lower lip. (dual. -रौ) The lips.
mn. (-रः or रं)
Pudendum muliebre.
E.
अ neg. धृ to have or hold, and अच् aff.

m. (-रः)
1 Support, prop, stay.
2

Receptacle.
3

Comprehension, location, the sense of the ablative in or on.
4 A dike, a canal.
5 A basin round the foot of a tree.
E.
आङ् and धृ to hold or contain, घञ् aff.

ind.
Underneath.
E.
अधर, and तस् aff.

n. (-घु)
The moisture of the lips.
E.
अधर the lower lip, and मधु honey.

ind.
Below, behind.
E.
स्तात् added to अधर.

ind.
Below, underneath.
E.
the form of the ablative.

ind.
Underneath.
E.
अधर, with the termination आत्.

n. (-तं)
The moisture, honey or nectar of the lips.
E.
अधर, and अमृत nectar.

m. (-पः)
Biting the lip.
E.
अधर, and अव before लुप to cut, affix धञ्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Contradicted, invalidated.
E.
अधर, and कृत made with च्ची inserted.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
Reproached, censured.
E.
अधर, and ख aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Contradicted, invalidated.
E.
अधर, and भूत become, with च्ची inserted.

ind.
Underneath.
E.
अधर, and the affix एन.

ind.
A future day, the day after the morrow.
E.
अधर, and एद्युस् irregular aff.

m. (-र्म्मः)
Unrighteousness, injustice, all behaviour contrary to the Śruti and Smṛti, or religious and legal institutes.
E.
अ priv. and धर्म्म virtue, &c.

mfn. (-रीः-रिणी-रि^1)
Unrighteous, wicked.
E.
अधम्म, and चारिन् who follows.
[1] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk on 20161123. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/321. note: print is missing a '-'.

f. (-ता)
Unrighteousness; also अधर्म्मत्व n. (-त्वं)
E.
ता or त्व added to अधर्म्म.

mfn. (-त्मा-त्मा-त्म)
Wicked, unrighteous.
E.
अधर्म्म, and आत्मन् spirit.

mfn. (र्म्मी-र्म्मिणी-र्म्मि)
Wicked, sinful, unrighteous.
E.
अधर्म्म, and इनि aff.

mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं)
Very wicked.
E.
अधर्म्म, and इष्ठन् aff.

mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं)
Going.
m. (-रः)
A thief.
E.
अधस् low, vile, and चर who goes down or below.

m. (-रः)
A house-breaker.
E.
अधस् below, and चौर a thief.

ind.
1 Down, downwards, below.
2 The lower or infernal regions.
2 Pudendum muliebre.
E.
अधर with असि affix, and र dropped.

mfn. (-नः-नी-नं)
Below, underneath.
E.
अधस्, and ट्युल् aff.

ind.
1 Down, downwards, underneath.
2

Behind.
3

Pudendum muliebre.
E.
अधर or अधम्, and तात् aff.

m. (-वः)
A plant, (Achyranthes aspera.)
E.
अधम vile, मार्ग a road, and व from वा to gain or possess.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Unjust, unrighteous, wicked.
E.
अ neg. and धार्म्मिक virtuous, &c. from धर्म्म, affix ठञ्.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Unjust, unrighteous.
E.
अ neg. धर्म्म virtue, &c. ठक् aff.

n. (-नं)
A pledge.

n. (-नं)
1 Conviction, (of crime or of error.)
2 Sentence, refutation.
2 Injuring, annoying.
E.
आङ् before धृष to be bold, ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Convicted, sentenced.
2 Refuted, disproved.
3 Injured, aggrieved.
E.
आङ् before धृष to be bold, affix क्त.

n. (-नं)
1 Taking, having.
2 Receiving, recovering.
3 A ceremony performed with consecrated fire.
4 A pledge, a deposit.
5 A surety.
6 A ceremony performed previous to conception: see गर्भाधान.
E.
आङ्, धा to have, affix ल्युट्.

n. (-कं)
A ceremony performed after cohabitation to procure or favour conception.
E.
आधान and ठक् affix: see the preceding.

ind.
Having deposited or placed.
E.
आङ् before धा to have, ल्यप् aff.

m. (-वः)
The influence or action of the support or recipient upon the thing received or supported.
E.
आधार support, &c. आधेय what is to be held, and भाव quality.
